title: quarry-index
intention: Compile a one-time, deduped index of TheIgorsProject's ARTICULATED layer — design docs, decisions, subsystem index, tickets — so that 'has this already been thought through?' is a lookup instead of a re-derivation. Every entry carries a provenance stamp marking it UNPROVEN-PRIOR-SYSTEM, so nothing from the quarry can ever read as settled.
why: Measured on 2026-07-26: in one session we re-derived the memory storage design by conversation for roughly an hour while it sat on disk with design docs, tickets and tests; separately reported 'no inference host' with ollama running four days; and were about to build the bus VERB without knowing UU had already solved it as a declared-capability Channel. Three stumbles, one root: prior art existed OUTSIDE the search scope. That is Law 1's defect in its purest form — the resolver spent re-deriving the settled. The fix is not more scanning (a per-skill scan is a poll, and would have missed all three anyway, since TheIgorsProject is in none of the three roots); the fix is to compile the quarry ONCE and give /challenge's existing 'prior art?' question something to search.
traces_to: Law 1 — every answered question becomes structure; re-deriving a settled answer is a defect. This node is Law 1 applied to the PRIOR system's answers.

Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass. The unproven stamp is what lets the quarry be READ without anything from it ENTERING. Grafting stays one ticket at a time.
Law 3 — every quarry claim is hypothesis-class by construction; the stamp says so on every entry rather than relying on a reader remembering.

MAP.md:539-548 — the pre-build steps (orient, constrain, deconstruct, plan) are the thing Delta Dental and UU both moved OUT of the model into deterministic code. A compiled index is that move; a per-call review is its opposite.

proves_green.prove_gate: proof gate — the tester runs the node's proof and emits a VALIDATION.
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until tested AND durably committed (git).

falsifier.proves_red: Three ideas ALREADY known to be in the quarry must each resolve, through the index, to a quarry DOCUMENT: (1) the declared-capability Channel pattern (uniform interface + declared cost/reliability/one_way); (2) calving's trigger threshold AND its protected-node list; (3) the node record envelope. Any of the three that resolves only to SOURCE CODE, or not at all, is a RED against the articulated-layer-only scope — it means the ideas do not in fact live in the docs. Additionally: any index entry lacking the unproven-prior-system stamp is a red. A hollow build (an empty index, or a file listing without content extraction) fails this.
falsifier.horizon: Re-checked at the FIRST graft that consumes it — the read pass over TheIgors' memory design. If that pass needs ideas the index did not surface, the scope was wrong and this reopens. The quarry itself is frozen (measured: 6 files touched since 2026-07-01, none of them design; not a git repo), so the index does NOT go stale from the quarry side — only from a scope error on ours.
